title: p2p_tokens data
description: Emitted when the P2P token list changes (generated or removed), and each time the p2p server refreshes its tokens' broker registrations, every 30 seconds.

ttl_ns.description: How long, in nanoseconds, the broker keeps the token's registration after a refresh: 60 seconds, the relay broker's default.

expires_at.description: When the broker drops the registration unless the server refreshes it first. Each refresh moves it on, so it stays about 30 seconds ahead while refreshes go out.

mode.description: "static" for a token derived for peer_pub_b64, "random" otherwise.

peer_pub_b64.description: Base64 public key of the peer that a static token was derived for.
